description: An expander for MEGA-TANG, sitting immediately to its right: a second effects send with its own four send levels and its own stereo return

params.text: Sets how much of that MEGA-TANG channel reaches this module's Send output, taken before that channel's level, pan and mute; it comes up at nothing

inputs.text: The left side of this send's return, added into MEGA-TANG's left mix output
The right side of this send's return, added into MEGA-TANG's right mix output; with nothing patched it takes the left return

outputs.text: The four MEGA-TANG channels at the send levels set here, added together and clamped to ±10V

notes: nothing here does anything unless MEGA-TANG is the module immediately to the left.
this send is taken from the channel inputs before their level, pan and mute controls, so it does not follow the mix. MEGA-TANG's own send is taken after them.
all four send knobs come up at nothing, so the Send output is silent until one is raised.
the module is monophonic: every jack reads or writes one channel.

inputs.0:
bipolar · continuous · one channel only

unpatched it reads 0V.
inputs.1:
bipolar · continuous · one channel only

unpatched it reads the left return.
